item.title: Trump says Ukraine and Russia are ‘closer than ever’ to peace after talks with Zelenskyy
item.description: President Donald Trump on Sunday insisted Ukraine and Russia are “closer than ever before” to a peace deal as he hosted Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at his Florida resort, but he acknowledged the negotiations are complex and could still break down, leaving the war dragging on for years. The post Trump says Ukraine and Russia are ‘closer than ever’ to peace after talks with Zelenskyy appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Titans try to focus on Jaguars knowing change is coming after season finale
item.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn. — The Tennessee Titans know change is coming once this season is finished, and the challenge now is staying focused on the finale. The post Titans try to focus on Jaguars knowing change is coming after season finale appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Judge orders release of transcript from closed hearing for man accused of killing Charlie Kirk
item.description: A Utah judge on Monday ordered the release of a transcript from a closed-door hearing in October over whether the man charged with killing Charlie Kirk must be shackled during court proceedings. The post Judge orders release of transcript from closed hearing for man accused of killing Charlie Kirk appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Andy Reid plans to return as Chiefs coach next season
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Monday that he plans to return next season, batting away any thought of an impending retirement by making a tongue-in-cheek joke about his status with a franchise he has led to three Super Bowl titles. The post Andy Reid plans to return as Chiefs coach next season appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Possumhaw: Nearing the New Year
item.description: The next two days will go by quickly. Tomorrow will be New Year’s Eve, bringing in an entirely new year full of who knows what? Our Christmas was nice and quiet, and I hope your Christmas was a good one as well. The day after Christmas we drove north to spend a brief bit of time with a lovely family member who now lives far away. The post Possumhaw: Nearing the New Year appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: Pipe bomb suspect told FBI he targeted US political parties because they were ‘in charge,’ memo says
item.description: The man accused of placing two pipe bombs in Washington on the eve of the Jan. 6, 2021, riot at the U.S. Capitol told investigators after his arrest that he believed someone needed to “speak up” for people who believed the 2020 election was stolen and that he wanted to target the country’s political parties because they were “in charge,” prosecutors said Sunday. item.title: China stages military drills around Taiwan to warn ‘external forces’ after US, Japan tensions
item.description: China’s military on Monday dispatched air, navy and missile units to conduct joint live-fire drills around the island of Taiwan, which Beijing called a “stern warning” against separatist and “external interference” forces. Taiwan said it was placing forces on alert and called the Chinese government “the biggest destroyer of peace.” The post China stages military drills around Taiwan to warn ‘external forces’ after US, Japan tensions appeared first on The Dispatch.
